title: Feature card
description: The first page of the featured view, large: its image across the column, its title as a link, its date and its teaser.

title.description: The page's title, as the card's link

image.description: The page's image, a raster image in the assets: across the column above the title, as decoration (the title says what the page is)

description.description: The teaser: the page's description, or its first paragraph. At most three lines are shown
